app.title: Show HN: Gemini 4 Argon plays StarCraft
app.author: __cayenne__
app.description: Gemini 4 Argon is an open-source LLM inference server that runs the Gemini 4 model locally. It exposes a REST API and a Python client, allowing developers to run and benchmark the model without an internet connection.
proposed_tests: pip install gemini4-argon && python -c "import argon; argon.run('Hello world')"
compare output quality against official Gemini 4 API
